owner.purpose: administrative wallet that proposes/executes delayed operations; also holds immediate emergency-pause authority at launch

guardian.purpose: immediate pause authority; use the same address as owner for the initial shared-control launch

distributionRecipient.purpose: team supply/distribution bookkeeping; not a required deploy-local address for externally supplied MOCHI

feeTreasury.purpose: accounting decision outside current deploy-local and phala-batch roles; no automatic swap or residual purchase is configured

juror.admission: each juror key/operator explicitly approved through the timelock; no deposit or customer insurance

constraints: Every required role wallet and enclave key must be a real, reviewed address/key; this manifest contains no fabricated production identities.

Owner and guardian may share one control wallet; compromise or loss affects both powers. Service signers and deployer remain separate from that wallet. Reopening and administrative changes still use the timelock.
The external MOCHI CA is supplied by the team. Production deployment uses --mochi-token and never deploys a MOCHI token.

Feed runner key and orchestrator key are separate signers in current orchestrator configuration. Indexer ANCHORER_KEY is optional in code, but mandatory for the stated separate indexer role if it submits anchors.
